items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: So I started taking private lessons from Chalamet.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was strict. He was strict.

Now, I went to him, that was around, I was 19, 20. And I stayed with him until around 21, or the first part, middle part of 22 or something like that. Well then, I got in this military band and they had a man, Professor Chalamet, I heard of him. See? Well after, so I stopped taking lessons with Professor Humphrey. While being in his band, he was teaching his band. So I started taking private lessons from Chalamet.

Well, you get back because, of course, some of the Humphreys are still living, the grandchildren, and Willie is still living, the son of your professor too. But I wonder, did he ever play any instrument at your lessons? Did you know what he was best on? What he... Trumpet. Trumpet was his main instrument. Did he ever play that during your lessons? No.
